nodes.label: PATTERNS.md — bouwblokken-bibliotheek
nodes.rationale: One place with reusable patterns so building a new template = choose + adapt instead of writing from scratch; lowers token cost (read PATTERNS.md + templates.json, copy from the named source template).

nodes.label: Gedeelde shell (skelet premium+ templates)
nodes.rationale: Fixed body order (skip-link, scroll-progress, intro, header, menu-overlay, main, footer) and a :root token grid (colors, easing, fonts, sizes) so every template is themeable by swapping variables; best complete shells to copy are templates 23 (dark) and 24 (light).

nodes.label: Animatie opt-in (reduced-motion-veilig)
nodes.rationale: html starts as class 'js no-anim'; inline head script removes no-anim only when the user does not prefer reduced motion. Without JS everything stays visible (end states kept), so animation is progressive enhancement.

nodes.label: Eén scroll-rAF-loop (header/progress/effecten in één frame)
nodes.rationale: All scroll-driven work batched in a single requestAnimationFrame tick with passive listeners, for performance.

nodes.label: Canvas-patroon (dpr-scaling, lazy IO-init, tab-pauze, reduced-motion fallback)
nodes.rationale: Signature-level canvas boilerplate: devicePixelRatio capped at 2, init only when in view, pause when tab hidden, static draw for reduced-motion; deterministic seeded rng so compositions are reproducible. Canvas stays untainted (pure-code placeholders) so toDataURL PNG export works.
nodes.norm_label: canvas-patroon (dpr-scaling, lazy io-init, tab-pauze, reduced-motion fallback)

nodes.label: Stijl- en schrijfregels (NL-teksten, a11y, performance, typografie)
nodes.rationale: Consistency = reusability: all UI text Dutch with plausible fictional NL brands; prefer pure CSS/canvas compositions over stock photos; accessibility (focus-visible, aria, skip-link, reduced-motion) and premium detail accents (grain overlay, dot-pulse, conic border, intro curtain) are mandatory house style.
nodes.norm_label: stijl- en schrijfregels (nl-teksten, a11y, performance, typografie)

nodes.label: Bron — verzameling van 165 kant-en-klare website-templates
nodes.rationale: Pure HTML/CSS/JS with no build tools or dependencies; the gallery is a reference library: a new site is built by copying the nearest template and adapting, not from scratch.

nodes.label: templates.json — doorzoekbare index / bron van waarheid
nodes.rationale: Read templates.json (sector, palette, fonts, mechanics, sections) to pick a template instead of opening every index.html — saves tokens; the gallery card data is generated from it so gallery and index never drift.
nodes.norm_label: templates.json — doorzoekbare index / bron van waarheid

nodes.label: _kit generator (core.css/core.js + sections.mjs + build.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Standard sector sites are ~70% boilerplate; the generator captures the shared shell once and expands a ~100-line recipe into a fully standalone index.html (core inlined, no runtime dependency). Signature showpieces stay hand-written.

nodes.label: Distributie-scripts (_kit/gallery.mjs, pack.mjs, readmes.mjs, npm run dist)
nodes.rationale: gallery.mjs writes gallery data from templates.json inline into index.html (between @gallery:start/@gallery:end) so it works over file:// without fetch/CORS; pack.mjs builds dependency-free downloads/<slug>.zip via Node zlib; readmes.mjs generates per-template READMEs.
nodes.norm_label: distributie-scripts (_kit/gallery.mjs, pack.mjs, readmes.mjs, npm run dist)
